items.reason: CONTESTED RULING, parked so it can be overturned. The coordinator asked me to rule on whether the CLAUDE.md underwater carve-out is a known issue that suppresses ss18m2's mechanism. I ruled NO SUPPRESSION, on the ground that the carve-out is the tail of known-issue N19, which the run-18 KI re-extraction rules carries NO suppression authority (it justifies itself by citing a section 'idle balance is automatically buffer' that does not exist at cf8de27). Intent IS evidenced - the paragraph plus test/AutoAnnihilate.t.sol:389 - and a human may reasonably reach wont-fix. But intent evidence is for the human to weigh; it is not a suppression the deduplicator may apply. If a human grants N19 authority, ss18m2 collapses to ss18q3 (the unqualified NatSpec) alone.
items.confidence: high on the ruling, medium on the resulting severity
